rules.note: CAP-73: an account created by XLM sent through the native Stellar Asset Contract gets no account_created effect; the effects transform handles only SAC events for contract calls.
CAP-73: a trustline created by the Stellar Asset Contract's trust() gets no trustline_created effect.

export_token_transfer builds the processor for unified events only, which rejects any transaction whose meta is not v4: ledgers with TransactionMeta v1 to v3, such as those stellar-core older than 23.0 emits. Stellar's public archive serves old ledgers with v4 meta, so exports from it are not affected.

match.error_contains: error reading from unified events stream, expected version 4 got 3

rules.note: A revocation that redeems pool shares in several pools gets one liquidity_pool_revoked effect: getLiquidityPoolAndProductDelta(nil) returns the first pool change only. Horizon's effects processor has the same call.

A pool-share trustline removed by an authorization revocation gets no trustline_removed effect; only ChangeTrust emits it, in stellar-etl and in Horizon. The effects-model counterpart of stellar/wallet-backend#817.

export_token_transfer turns a text or hash memo into a muxed destination with ID 0: to_muxed is an M address although the CAP-67 event's to_muxed_id is a memo, not an ID. Rule written after reading the issue.

allow_trust emits trustline_flags_updated (26) in every branch; Horizon emits trustline_authorized (23), trustline_deauthorized (24) or trustline_authorized_to_maintain_liabilities (25) first, and those types do not exist in stellar-etl's schema. Rule written after reading the issue.

A trade claim emits offer_created, offer_updated and offer_removed effects for buyer and seller per claimed offer (6 to 8 rows), more than the offer entries the operation changed; Horizon emits only trade effects. Rule written after reading the issue; it applies only to operations in which a trade happened.

match.how: more than the ledger changed, in a trade

rules.note: create_contract details omit the salt of an address preimage, and contract_id is the first contract-data key of the footprint rather than the ID the preimage gives. Rule written after reading the issue.

history_contract_events appends the transaction's DiagnosticEvents after its operation and transaction events with no dedup, so a successful call's contract events, which the diagnostic list repeats, are exported twice; and in_successful_contract_call is hard-coded true for operation and transaction events, also in failed transactions. Filed by chowbao (P1).

rounding_slippage of a liquidity-pool trade: the strict-receive branch calls CalculatePoolPayout where Horizon calls CalculatePoolExpectation, and on overflow the strict-send branch sets math.MinInt64 where Horizon sets math.MaxInt64. Filed by chowbao (P1). The oracle's port of both formulas matches Horizon v30.0.1 on every pool trade in the corpus.
